priorityList.notes: Ghostly Strike on cooldown: cheaper energy than Backstab and applies its own attack power debuff. Does not spend combo points, so it is safe to check ahead of the finisher below.

Eviscerate at five combo points, checked ahead of Slice and Dice's refresh so a full five-point finisher is never given up in favor of a refresh. Was starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit here instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five.

Slice and Dice: only ever spend combo points on it once there are five banked, and only when it actually needs it -- down entirely, or under 3s remaining. Kept at the same five-combo-point floor as Eviscerate above so combo points are never spent below five on either finisher; Eviscerate above claims the combo points whenever both are ready in the same instant.

Hemorrhage as the combo point builder: Subtlety's talent-granted replacement for Sinister Strike, and its bleed needs reapplying once its charges run out. Gated on spellIsKnown so a bare build without the talent falls through to the Sinister Strike/Backstab line below instead of losing its only builder.

Fix round: the ladder's bare build has zero points in Hemorrhage below the level its tier is reachable (tier 4 of the Subtlety tree), leaving no combo-point builder at all -- Sinister Strike as the fallback builder whenever Hemorrhage is not known, the same auraIsKnown/spellIsKnown gate shape mage-fire uses for Improved Scorch (12873).
